# Antibody (অ্যান্টিবডি)

> An interactive bilingual (Bangla & English) browser game teaching first-time digital users to recognize and resist mobile-money and phone scams in Dhaka.

## Key Pages
- `/` — Field Agent Registration & Guest Entry
- `/case-file` — Case Dossier Introduction
- `/wallet-sandbox` — Taka-Pay Simulated Wallet Tutorial
- `/scam-call` — Live Scammer Bot Simulation
- `/tactic-xray` — Psychological Pathogen Autopsy
- `/antibody-lab` — Cognitive Defense Rule Builder
- `/mutation-exam` — Mixed Real & Scam Classification Exam
- `/report` — Bayesian Susceptibility Map & Homeworld Postcard

## Privacy & Ethics
- 100% free educational simulation; all brands (Taka-Pay) and balances are fictional.
- Collects zero emails, phone numbers, real names, or tracking cookies.
